description: The deposit describes the spatial extents of emergency ordinances in force during and after the July 2021 floods in the Netherlands. The native geolocation specifies Limburg and Noord-Brabant. Deltares, VU Amsterdam and TU Delft provide the source metadata. Its parent fact-finding study includes crisis management and flood defences and was commissioned by the Dutch Expertise Network Flood Risk. Coverage: Limburg and Noord-Brabant in the Netherlands during July 2021. Format and access: Zipfile with shapefile. Public native metadata identifies the deposit. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. File access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The resource describes emergency-response governance areas, with shapefiles in a ZIP. Exact ordinance provisions, geometry resolution, activation times, legal validity and completeness are unstated. Geographic boundaries alone do not establish evacuations or service disruption; the deposit is distinct from the collection flood-extent maps. Simulation use: The native member and parent establish the specific simulation or experimental role described above. Related members retain their separate original source identities.
